big_case.notes: Paid, counseled state-prisoner habeas petition asking whether section 2244(d)(1)'s one-year limit reaches a petition styled under section 2241. The split is real but old and shallow (Cox v. McBride against five circuits, 2002-2006), the decision below is an unpublished COA denial, the custody claim rests on an idiosyncratic two-state executive agreement, no response was called for, and the petition was denied on its first distribution with no writing. Low stakes; a resolution would matter to habeas timing practice but this vehicle drew no attention. Formed from the record and outcome; the predictors' scores were visible in the staged prediction.json while I read it, which I note rather than deny.
